notes.title: Windows Slowdown Patch
notes.content:
[h1]TripTrip Windows Patch[/h1]

[h3]It's been a while[/h3]

Hey there everyone! It's been a while. TripTrip's been out for almost 3 years now! Hard to believe.

[h3]Windows, y u do dis[/h3]

Recently, it was brought to my attention that the game was only running at like 45fps instead of the 60fps it should have. That 45 fps is not just the framerate of the game, it's also the [i]room speed[/i] in GameMaker - everything was running in slow motion!

This made the game frighteningly easy... and we can't have that. But more importantly, it caused some stuff with very specific timings to stop working properly.

If you're curious about the bug, there's some info about it over on YoyoGames' [url=https://forum.yoyogames.com/index.php?threads/slowdown-fix-for-windows-10-scheduler-patch.82867/]legacy GameMaker forums[/url].

[h3]By the way...[/h3]

As far as we know, no player has yet to reach the "Good Ending" of the game. This requires you to beat the game on Normal difficulty or higher after collecting all 9 bonus tokens.

Check out this random screenshot from the Good ending. How crazy is this?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32810877/3809355e8e2d5e796540f1fdccd79e8450cd5dd7.png[/img]

It's pretty crazy. Whoa, check out this guy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32810877/04be100b9bbb4e4119fdd88e672dccca58c17a9a.gif[/img]

Who the heck is that? Guess you'll have to beat the Good Ending to find out. If you send a screenshot of you beating the game's Good Ending to the [url=https://twitter.com/aboutairplane]About Airplane Twitter[/url], I'll give you a shoutout to this audience (small as it is). I may even subscribe to your Twitch or something. Who knows. We'll see!

[h3]Anyway[/h3]

Thanks for playing our game to whatever capacity you did play it. I think this post shows up for Wishlisters too. If you Wishlisted this game, thanks for that too! You're great. Are you somehow reading this without having bought or wishlisted the game? You're great too. Everyone's great.

Thanks,

Zach
Chief Airplane Officer
About Airplane LLC
